descriptive_cpu_signal_rule: all paired deltas negative and absolute mean paired delta greater than2 times sample standard deviation; apply separately to renderer-family and whole-board CPU for main and noJPEG controls
control_sample_size_limit: Two control pairs only; no probability or universal claim from this rule
quality: PCM/pause/resume/cancel, command coverage, camera availability and continuity must be reported with all runs retained. Missing or changed workload coverage prevents unconditional resource conclusion. Lower camera cadence associated with candidate counts against it.
memory: PSS and MemAvailable/Mali reported independently; do not sum overlapping GPU/CMA/PSS allocations
GPU_utilization: UNKNOWN when non-updating raw nodes, never infer zero load
attribution: C-B removes JPEG generation feature gap only; transport, presenter, public snapshot cadence and prewarm still differ. A-C is temporally separated descriptive comparison, not paired or additive.
overall_resource_score: UNDEFINED; no composite saving when CPU/GPU/RAM trade off
replacement: User decision only; never automatic production cutover
window_scope: Isolated mapped foreground renderer plus unchanged realUI/camera background, no 8792/27B/ASR concurrency.
